about: Absorb Bulb acts on a hit before Berserk answers it (Pokemon Central, Furore: "Bulbo, Vulneropolizza e Muschioluce si attivano prima di Furore"; Showdown's gen-9 items in onDamagingHit, Berserk in onAfterMoveSecondary), while a Sitrus Berry still comes after it (Furore: Berserk acts before the HP is restored). A level-10 Pikachu is given Water Gun in the running battle (teach:) against a forced wild level-5 Chansey that knows only Splash, given Berserk and an Absorb Bulb and set to 21 of its 40 HP (set:): the Water Gun takes it to half or below, and "The Absorb Bulb boosted the wild Chansey's Sp. Atk!" comes before "The wild Chansey's Berserk raised its Sp. Atk!" (before, after it). Then given a Sitrus Berry and set to 21 again, the next Water Gun has Berserk raise its Sp. Atk first and the Berry restore its HP after. The damage roll is forced to the bottom of the range; the field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.

lines: The Absorb Bulb boosted the wild Chansey’s Sp. Atk!
The wild Chansey’s Berserk raised its Sp. Atk!
